groups.title: Pre-Start
items: Ejection seat – ARMED (lever down), harness lever – FWD
(Optional) Fire & Bleed Air test – Channel A (fwd), hold until audio ends
(Optional) Cycle battery OFF/ON to rewind tape, or wait 10 s
(Optional) Fire & Bleed Air test – Channel B (aft), hold until audio ends

groups.title: APU & Right Engine
items: No APU ACC caution on standby caution panel
APU ACC caution visible, APU spooling
At 25 % RPM: right throttle OFF → IDLE (RSHIFT+HOME)
RPM stabilises 60–65 %, R GEN caution out

groups.title: Displays & Systems
items: Bleed air knob – rotate 360° back to NORM (reopens bleed valves)

groups.title: INS Alignment
items: (Optional) HSI: STD HDG for a ~90 s alignment (normal ≈ 8 min)
Monitor GRND QUAL timer on AMPCD
Wait for OK next to GRND QUAL (continue the start meanwhile, switch INS when done)
INS selector – IFA (GPS, 1986+) or NAV (no GPS)

groups.title: FCS Reset & Left Engine
items: FCS RESET button – press, X's clear
LIGHTS TEST – hold, check cautions illuminate
At 25 % RPM: left throttle OFF → IDLE (RALT+HOME)
RPM stabilises 60–65 %, L GEN caution out
APU shuts down automatically ~1 min after both engines idle

groups.title: Configure
items: FCS BIT: BIT page → FCS-MC, hold FCS BIT switch (Y) + press FCS OSB
AMPCD gain/contrast as required (NGT at night)
AMPCD: TIME → UFC: ZTOD (zulu time on HUD)
Wings – SPREAD & locked if on shore (keep folded on carrier)
BINGO fuel – set on IFEI (e.g. 8000 lbs)

groups.title: Datalink, Helmet & Lights
items: IFF – UFC IFF, hold ON until XP; verify mode 4A
Link-16 – UFC D/L twice, hold ON
Audio panel volumes – incl. MIDS A & B up
MIDS SUPT page – verify datalink info
Helmet: \ → F8 Ground Crew → F8 → F1 JHMCS / F2 NVG
[JHMCS] SUPT → BIT → DISPLAYS → HMD; wait until done, STOP → HMD GO
[JHMCS] SUPT → HMD → ALIGN; align crosses, hold C > 2.5 s until ALIGN OK
[JHMCS] (Optional) fine alignment with TDC, then unbox ALIGN to save
DTC: SUPT → MUMI, load each data type
Chocks – remove: canopy open, \ → F8 → F4 → F2

groups.title: Takeoff
items: Anti-skid ON, flaps HALF, chocks removed, launch bar RETRACT, parking brake off
Taxi – NWS with pedals; hold S for NWS HI (±75°)
Lined up: hold brakes, throttle 80 % RPM
Positive climb: gear UP before 240 kts

groups.title: Taxi to Catapult
items: INS aligned in CV, then IFA (GPS) or NAV
Chocks removed (canopy open, \ → F8 → F4 → F2)
Check the catapult is clear; wait behind JBD if occupied
No taxi director? \ → F8 → F8 Request Launch
Follow taxi director onto catapult; stop when fists close

groups.title: Hook Up
items: Wings – SPREAD, then push lever in to lock (WING UNLK clears)
Throttle up to hook into shuttle (U if no Supercarrier), then idle
Launch bar – RETRACT when signalled (stays seated in shuttle)
Set catapult trim per weight (see Quick Ref), check SUPT FCS page
Control wipeout – stick & rudder full travel

groups.title: Launch
items: On run-up signal: MAX afterburner (raise finger lifts 0 & 9)
Salute the shooter (LCTRL+LSHIFT+S or \ → F8 → F9)
After the cat stroke: take the stick on positive climb
Clearing turn 20° left; 500 ft / 300 kts until 7 nm

groups.title: Overhead Break
items: Break turn: pull G ≈ 1 % of airspeed, VV on horizon
Slow to 250 kts, descend to 600 ft
Downwind: trim to on-speed (VV in E bracket, ~8.1° AoA, 140–150 kts)
Base turn: 30° bank, hold 600 ft with throttle
Final: VV on runway, pitch for speed, power for altitude
Nose gear down, toe brakes to stop

groups.title: Setup
items: COMM1: Manual, FM, 127.500, ENT; RALT+\ → F5 ATC → CVN → F1 Inbound
Anti-skid OFF, hook DOWN, hook bypass CARRIER, landing light ON
ALT switch RDR, radalt index 370 or 320 ft

groups.title: Pattern
items: Break: pull G ≈ 1 % of airspeed, VV on horizon
Trim on-speed: VV in E bracket, ~8.1° AoA (critical)
Start turn when wing meets the ship's rounddown
Approach turn: 30° bank, hold altitude, ignore airspeed
Wings level in the groove: call the ball

groups.title: Groove & Trap
items: Fly the meatball, E bracket & AoA indexer (not the deck)
Ball high → slightly less power; low → more power; small corrections
Touch down on-speed: NO FLARE, no brakes
On touchdown: throttle to MIL (bolter protection)
Stopped: idle, hook UP, flaps UP, fold wings, taxi clear

quickref.title: Key Bindings Used in Procedures
rows: Finger lifts (AB with launch bar/hook down)
